# SEO-210: Write anchor text that describes the destination

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

## Statement

The visible text of an internal link states what the linked page is, so the link remains meaningful when read on its own, and generic wording such as click here or read more is replaced or supplemented with an accessible name.

## Rationale

The anchor text is the only description of a destination available before it is fetched, and a link whose text carries no information forces both readers and crawlers to fetch the page to learn whether it was worth following.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Replace the generic phrase with the destination title, or keep the phrase and attach the accessible name through an attribute so assistive technology reports the destination. For icon-only links, supply the name rather than relying on the icon.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Collect the accessible name of every internal link in the served response and report links whose name is empty or matches a known generic phrase.
- Evidence: `RENDERED_HTML`, `ACCESSIBILITY_SCAN`, `ROUTE`
- Automated check: none.

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_SEARCH`, `BING_SEARCH`
